headline: Amnesty International Calls For Release Of Detained FIJ Journalist
seoTitle: Amnesty Demands Release Of Journalist Daniel Ojukwu
metaDescription: Amnesty International and other public figures demand the immediate release of journalist Daniel Ojukwu following his remand in a federal prison.
aiSummaryBullets: Amnesty International Nigeria has formally requested the immediate and unconditional release of journalist Daniel Ojukwu.
The journalist, who works for the Foundation for Investigative Journalism, was remanded in custody by a Federal High Court.
Legal proceedings against Ojukwu are reportedly linked to his 2023 reports concerning a former presidential aide.
aiContextParagraph: Journalist Daniel Ojukwu, associated with the Foundation for Investigative Journalism (FIJ), is currently being held in Kuje prison following a court-ordered remand. The legal action is reportedly connected to allegations of cybercrime stemming from investigative reports he authored in 2023 regarding a former aide to the former president. The detention has drawn public scrutiny, with Amnesty International Nigeria leading calls for his immediate and unconditional release. Furthermore, political figures, including Omoyele Sowore, have publicly demanded that authorities release the journalist. The case has become a focal point for concerns regarding media freedom and legal processes involving journalists in the region. Court documents indicate that the remand order was issued by a Federal High Court, though details surrounding the specific charges remain tied to the allegations regarding his previous professional reporting on high-profile public figures.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to public statements from prominent human rights organizations and political figures, coupled with sustained reporting from multiple news outlets.
